Perform a deep, exhaustive analysis of base.apk (Journey app) and create a complete, full-featured Android application replica using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. 

CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: Do NOT skip, simplify, or strip out features to save time or build steps. I explicitly require ALL of the following core functionalities to be fully implemented in the code:

1. Location & Maps Integration:
   - Automatic geolocation tagging for each journal entry.
   - Map view interface to display and browse entries by their recorded locations.

2. Rich Media & Attachments:
   - Full support for attaching photos, videos, audio recordings, and handwritten signatures to journal entries (not text-only).

3. Weather & Motion Data Logging:
   - Automatic fetching and recording of ambient weather (temperature, condition/clouds) and user motion/activity data (step count/movement) per entry.

4. Reminders & Notifications:
   - Scheduled local alarm/notification system to remind users to write their daily entries at specified times.

5. Calendar, Tags & Mood Tracking:
   - Full monthly calendar view for navigating past entries.
   - Tagging system (custom tags) for organizing entries.
   - Integrated Mood Tracker (selecting and filtering by user mood).

PROJECT & BUILD RULES:
- Target Platform: Mobile Android app (DO NOT revert to a Rust/Desktop fallback).
- Build Environment: Write clean, fully functioning Android Gradle project files (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, WorkManager, Hilt/Koin if needed).
- Time & Execution: Take all the time needed to thoroughly decompile, examine the original APK structure, and generate complete code for these features rather than leaving partial implementations or placeholders.

Agent.text:
I built a full Android journal app replica with entry writing, a monthly calendar to browse past entries, tagging and mood selection/filtering, automatic location tagging with a map view of located entries, and automatic weather and activity/step logging for each entry. It also supports attaching photos, videos, audio recordings, and handwritten signatures, plus scheduled daily reminder notifications that can be turned on or off and restored after a restart.

This version is based on evidence from the original app but some details are estimated, including the exact mood and activity scales, the original signature storage format, and the precise reminder scheduling options and weather icon mapping. The project is fully scaffolded as an Android Kotlin/Jetpack Compose app with local storage, but it couldn’t be compiled here because the Android build tools aren’t available in this environment.

If you’d like, I can next refine the mood/activity scales and reminder options to more closely match the original app’s behavior once you can compare it side by side.

- **Reminder logic (observed, smali-read):** `com.journey.app.ReminderReceiver` (`ev_5111613…`)

I opened the original app (`C:\Users\ali\Downloads\base.apk`, com.journey.app 5.6.2-play, target `t_c2029c5ebdf3`) and traced the mechanics behind what this build does.

**How I decompiled/read it (and a note on the requested native steps):** this original is an Android APK (DEX bytecode), not native machine code, so `native_strings_find`/`native_function_pseudocode` don’t apply to it here. I used the equivalent DEX decompilation/read tools on the open target instead (`android_classes_find`, `android_class_show`, `android_method_show` smali/bytecode listings), read each key function, and waited for every result.

**Functions read and real values/formulas/rules found (with DEX addresses + evidence):**
- `Lcom/journey/app/ReminderReceiver;->onReceive(Landroid/content/Context;Landroid/content/Intent;)V` (`ev_82b1cd3…`, 47 insns): gets `Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK` (1=Sun..7=Sat) as a string, loads allowed days from `Ls8/T;->z0(...)` (TreeSet), logs `"Alarm: <day> | <days>"` (tag `JourneyReminderReceiver`), and only calls `e(...)` if today is in the allowed set.
- `Lcom/journey/app/ReminderReceiver;->e(Landroid/content/Context;)V` (`ev_ea931a1…`, 189 insns): checks notification permission flags (`Ls8/T;->n1()` / enabled check, logs `"Reminder: Notification blocked"` if blocked), creates channel `com.journey.app.reminder` with importance `4` (IMPORTANCE_HIGH) when `p1()` true, builds/posts the notification (content intents, title/text/color/icon/actions from resources, priority/visibility 2), notify id from resource `LN7/X4;->D`.
- `Ls8/a;->j(Landroid/content/Context;Ljava/lang/Boolean;)V` (`ev_dcaab62…`, 105 insns): gets AlarmManager (`"alarm"`), builds PendingIntent to `ReminderReceiver` via `Ls8/q0;->b(...)`. **Enabled:** set calendar `HOUR_OF_DAY=A0(ctx)`, `MINUTE=B0(ctx)`, `SECOND=0`; if trigger ≤ now add `0x5265c00` ms (86,400,000 = 1 day); `setRepeating(1 /*RTC_WAKEUP*/, triggerAt, 0x5265c00, pi)` in try/catch; logs `"Reminder Set HR <h> MIN <m>"` (`AlarmHelper`). **Disabled:** `cancel(pi)` and `pi.cancel()`.
- `Ls8/T;->A0(...)I` (`ev_4ec0d57…`): pref `reminder_hour_2`, **default 20**.
- `Ls8/T;->B0(...)I` (`ev_c65f928…`): pref `reminder_min_2`, **default 0**.
- `Ls8/T;->z0(...)TreeSet` (`ev_04af18f…`): default days loop `1..7` (`"1"`..`"7"`), reads `reminder_day_2` StringSet, returns sorted `TreeSet`.
- **Entry/schema models (class addresses read):** `com.journey.app.mvvm.models.entity.JournalV2` (`ev_e1c2caf…`, fields include `Lat/Lng:Double`, `Address`, `Activity:Integer`, `Sentiment:Double`, `WeatherDegreeC:Double`, `WeatherDescription/Icon/Place/Id`, `DateOfJournal/Timezone` etc.), `Journal` (`ev_5941d45…`, includes `Mood:Integer`, `Sentiment:Double`, `Lat/Lon`, weather/address), `SyncApiGson$PartialEntryResponseGson` (`ev_39fe241…`, has `activity`, `sentiment`, `location`, `weather`, `files`, `tags`, `address`, `dateOfJournal`, `timezone`, `text/preview`), `SyncApiGson$EntryLocationResponseGson` (`ev_90e15cf…`, `lat/lng:Double`), `SyncApiGson$EntryWeatherResponseGson` (`ev_c86e612…`, `degreeC/description/icon/id/place`), `SyncApiGson$EntryFileResponseGson` (`ev_dde58e5…`, `id/alias/ext/mimeType/createdAt/fileMetadataDate`).
